note: HUD LMA_PuertoRico_CDBG_DR layer "LowModTractCDBG-DR" (977 rows, geography field GEOID). cdbg_dr_lmi_pct = 100 x sum(Est_LowMod) / sum(Personas_T) over the rows of each tract and each municipio.
